H6700.def: from «06697» and «0410»; rock of God; Tsuriel, an Israelite:--Zuriel.

H6701.def: from «06697» and «07706»; rock of (the) Almighty; Tsurishaddai, an Israelite:--Zurishaddai.

H6703.def: from «06705»; dazzling, i.e. sunny, bright, (figuratively) evident:--clear, dry, plainly, white.

H6704.et: from an unused root meaning to glow
H6704.def: from an unused root meaning to glow; parched:--dried up.

H6705.def: a primitive root; to glare, i.e. be dazzling white:--be whiter.

H6706.def: from «06705»; glaring, i.e. exposed to the bright sun:--higher place, top.

H6707.def: feminine of «06706»; a parched region, i.e. the desert:--dry land.

H6708.def: from «06706»; bare spot, i.e. in the glaring sun:--higher place.

H6709.et: from an unused root meaning to putrefy
H6709.def: from an unused root meaning to putrefy; stench:--ill savour.

H6710.def: from «06705»; a dry place, i.e. desert:--drought.

H6711.def: a primitive root; to laugh outright (in merriment or scorn); by implication, to sport:--laugh, mock, play, make sport.

H6712.def: from «06711»; laughter (in pleasure or derision):--laugh(-ed to scorn).

H6713.et: from an unused root meaning to dazzle
H6713.def: from an unused root meaning to dazzle; sheen, i.e. whiteness:--white.

H6714.def: from the same as «06713»; whiteness; Tsochar, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite:--Zohar. Compare «03328».

H6717.def: from the same as «06678»; station; Tsiba, an Israelite:--Ziba.

H6718.et: from a form of (06679) and meaning the same
H6718.def: from a form of «06679» and meaning the same; the chase; also game (thus taken); (generally) lunch (especially for a journey):--X catcheth, food, × hunter, (that which he took in) hunting, venison, victuals.

H6719.def: from the same as «06718»; a huntsman:--hunter.

H6720.def: or tsedah {tsay-daw'}; feminine of «06718»; food:--meat, provision, venison, victuals.

H6721.et: from (06679) in the sense of catching fish
H6721.def: or Tsiydon {tsee-done'}; from «06679» in the sense of catching fish; fishery; Tsidon, the name of a son of Canaan, and of a place in Palestine:--Sidon, Zidon.

H6722.def: patrial from «06721»; a Tsidonian or inhabitant of Tsidon:--Sidonian, of Sidon, Zidonian.

H6723.et: from an unused root meaning to parch
H6723.def: from an unused root meaning to parch; aridity; concretely, a desert:--barren, drought, dry (land, place), solitary place, wilderness.

H6724.def: from the same as «06723»; a desert:--dry place.

H6725.et: from the same as (06723) in the sense of conspicuousness [compare (05329)]
H6725.def: from the same as «06723» in the sense of conspicuousness (compare «05329»); a monumental or guiding pillar:--sign, title, waymark.

H6726.def: the same (regularly) as «06725»; Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem:--Zion.

H6727.def: or Tsicha( {tsee-khaw'}; as if feminine of «06704»; drought; Tsicha, the name of two Nethinim:--Ziha.

H6728.def: from the same as «06723»; a desert-dweller, i.e. nomad or wild beast:--wild beast of the desert, that dwell in (inhabiting) the wilderness.

H6729.et: from an unused root meaning to confine
H6729.def: from an unused root meaning to confine; the pillory:--stocks.

H6730.def: from «06819»; small; Tsior, a place in Palestine:--Zior.

H6731.def: or tsits {tseets}; from «06692»; properly, glistening, i.e. a burnished plate; also a flower (as bright-colored); a wing (as gleaming in the air):--blossom, flower, plate, wing.

H6732.def: the same as «06731»; bloom; Tsits, a place in Palestine:--Ziz.

H6734.def: feminine of «06731»; a floral or wing-like projection, i.e. a forelock of hair, a tassel:--fringe, lock.

H6735.def: from «06696»; a hinge (as pressed in turning); also a throe (as a phys. or mental pressure); also a herald or errand-doer (as constrained by the principal):--ambassador, hinge, messenger, pain, pang, sorrow. Compare «06736».

H6736.def: the same as «06735»; a form (of beauty; as if pressed out, i.e. carved); hence, an (idolatrous) image:--beauty, idol.

H6737.et: a denominative from (06735) in the sense of ambassador
H6737.def: a denominative from «06735» in the sense of ambassador; to make an errand, i.e. betake oneself:--make as if...had been ambassador.

H6738.def: from «06751»; shade, whether literal or figurative:--defence, shade(-ow).

H6739.et: probably corresponding to (06760) in the sense of bowing
H6739.def: (Aramaic) probably corresponding to «06760» in the sense of bowing; pray:--pray.

H6741.def: feminine of «06738»; Tsillah, an antediluvian woman:--Zillah.

H6742.et: from (06749) in the sense of rolling
H6742.def: from «06749» in the sense of rolling; a (round or flattened) cake:--cake.

H6743.def: or tsaleach {tsaw-lay'-akh}; a primitive root; to push forward, in various senses (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive):--break out, come (mightily), go over, be good, be meet, be profitable, (cause to, effect, make to, send) prosper(-ity, -ous, - ously).

H6744.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «06743»; to advance (transitive or intransitive):--promote, prosper.

H6745.def: from «06743»; something protracted or flattened out, i.e. a platter:--pan.

H6746.def: from «06743»; something prolonged or tall, i.e. a vial or salt-cellar:--cruse.

H6747.def: from «06743»; something advanced or deep, i.e. a bowl; figuratively, the bosom:--bosom, dish.

H6749.def: a primitive root; properly, to tumble down, i.e. settle by a waving motion:--sink. Compare «06750», «06751».

H6750.et: a primitive root [identical with (06749) through the idea of vibration]
H6750.def: a primitive root (identical with «06749» through the idea of vibration); to tinkle, i.e. rattle together (as the ears in reddening with shame, or the teeth in chattering with fear):--quiver, tingle.

H6751.et: a primitive root [identical with (06749) through the idea of hovering over (compare (06754))]
H6751.def: a primitive root (identical with «06749» through the idea of hovering over (compare «06754»)); to shade, as twilight or an opaque object:--begin to be dark, shadowing.

H6753.et: from (06752) and the act part of (06437)
H6753.def: from «06752» and the active participle of «06437»; shade-facing; Tselelponi, an Israelitess:--Hazelelponi (including the article).

H6754.et: from an unused root meaning to shade
H6754.def: from an unused root meaning to shade; a phantom, i.e. (figuratively) illusion, resemblance; hence, a representative figure, especially an idol:--image, vain shew.

H6755.def: (Aramaic) or tslem (Aramaic) {tsel-em'}; corresponding to «06754»; an idolatrous figure:--form, image.

H6756.def: from «06754»; shady; Tsalmon, the name of a place in Palestine and of an Israelite:--Zalmon.

H6757.def: from «06738» and «04194»; shade of death, i.e. the grave (figuratively, calamity):--shadow of death.

H6758.def: feminine of «06757»; shadiness; Tsalmonah, a place in the Desert:--Zalmonah.

H6759.def: from «06738» and «04513»; shade has been denied; Tsalmunna, a Midianite:--Zalmunna.

H6760.et: a primitive root: probably to curve
H6760.def: a primitive root: probably to curve; used only as denominative from «06763», to limp (as if one-sided):--halt.

H6761.def: from «06760»; a limping or full (figuratively):--adversity, halt(-ing).

H6762.def: the same as «06761»; Tsela, a place in Palestine:--Zelah.

H6763.def: or (feminine) tsalTah {tsal-aw'}; from «06760»; a rib (as curved), literally (of the body) or figuratively (of a door, i.e. leaf); hence, a side, literally (of a person) or figuratively (of an object or the sky, i.e. quarter); architecturally, a (especially floor or ceiling) timber or plank (single or collective, i.e. a flooring):--beam, board, chamber, corner, leaf, plank, rib, side (chamber).

H6764.et: from an unused root of unknown meaning
H6764.def: from an unused root of unknown meaning; Tsalaph, an Israelite:--Zalaph.

H6765.def: from the same as «06764» and «0259»; Tselophchad, an Israelite:--Zelophehad.

H6766.def: from «06738» and «06703»; clear shade; Tseltsach, a place in Palestine:--Zelzah.

H6767.def: from «06750» reduplicated; a clatter, i.e. (abstractly) whirring (of wings); (concretely) a cricket; also a harpoon (as rattling), a cymbal (as clanging):--cymbal, locust, shadowing, spear.

H6768.et: from an unused root meaning to split
H6768.def: from an unused root meaning to split; fissure; Tselek, an Israelite:--Zelek.

H6769.def: from the feminine of «06738»; shady; Tsillethai, the name of two Israelites:--Zilthai.

H6770.def: a primitive root; to thirst (literally or figuratively):--(be a-, suffer) thirst(-y).

H6774.def: from «06771»; a thirsty place, i.e. desert:--drought, dry ground, thirsty land.

H6775.def: a primitive root; to link, i.e. gird; figuratively, to serve, (mentally) contrive:--fasten, frame, join (self).

H6776.def: a yoke or team (i.e. pair); hence, an acre (i.e. day's task for a yoke of cattle to plough):--acre, couple, × together, two (donkeys), yoke (of oxen).

H6777.et: from an unused root meaning to fasten on
H6777.def: from an unused root meaning to fasten on; a veil:--locks.

H6778.def: from «06784»; a cake of dried grapes:--bunch (cluster) of raisins.

H6779.def: a primitive root; to sprout (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative):--bear, bring forth, (cause to, make to) bud (forth), (cause to, make to) grow (again, up), (cause to) spring (forth, up).

H6780.def: from «06779»; a sprout (usually concrete), literal or figurative:--branch, bud, that which (where) grew (upon), spring(-ing).

H6781.def: or tsamid {tsaw-meed'}; from «06775»; a bracelet or arm-clasp; generally, a lid:--bracelet, covering.

H6782.def: from the same as «06777»; a noose (as fastening); figuratively, destruction:--robber.

H6783.def: or tsmithuth {tsem-ee-thooth'}; from «06789»; excision, i.e. destruction; used only (adverbially) with prepositional prefix to extinction, i.e. perpetually:--ever.

H6784.def: a primitive root; to dry up:--dry.

H6785.et: from an unused root probably meaning to be shaggy
H6785.def: from an unused root probably meaning to be shaggy; wool:--wool(-len).

H6786.et: from an unused name of a place in Palestine
H6786.def: patrial from an unused name of a place in Palestine; a Tsemarite or branch of the Canaanites:--Zemarite.

H6787.def: dual of «06785»; double fleece; Tsemarajim, a place in Palestine:--Zemaraim.

H6788.def: from the same as «06785»; fleeciness, i.e. foliage:--highest branch, top.

H6789.def: a primitive root; to extirpate (literally or figuratively):--consume, cut off, destroy, vanish.

H6790.et: from an unused root meaning to prick
H6790.def: from an unused root meaning to prick; a crag; Tsin, a part of the Desert:--Zin.

H6791.et: from an unused root meaning to be prickly
H6791.def: from an unused root meaning to be prickly; a thorn; hence, a cactus-hedge:--thorn.

H6793.def: feminine of «06791»; a hook (as pointed); also a (large) shield (as if guarding by prickliness); also cold (as piercing):-- buckler, cold, hook, shield, target.

H6794.et: from an unused root perhaps meaning to be hollow
H6794.def: from an unused root perhaps meaning to be hollow; a culvert:--gutter, water-spout.

H6795.def: a primitive root; to alight; (transitive) to cause to descend, i.e. drive down:--fasten, light (from off).

H6796.def: or tsanin {tsaw-neen'}; from the same as «06791»; a thorn:--thorn.

H6797.def: or tsanowph {tsaw-nofe'}; or (feminine) tsaniyphah {tsaw-nee-faw'}; from «06801»; a head-dress (i.e. piece of cloth wrapped around):--diadem, hood, mitre.

H6798.def: a primitive root; to blast or shrink:--withered.

H6799.def: probably for «06630»; Tsenan, a place near Palestine:--Zenan.
